text: no cue: first minute, on the wash at about sustainable shaft power; set pod-based watches

arguments.text: Lift a little, get back on their wash and stay.

text: hang_on: wash benefit fading as shaft power slipped to 188 W, below the 203 W the pod reserve can sustain to the finish

arguments.text: Lift a touch, settle at 1:45 pace and hold it.

text: push: off the wash at 192 W shaft, 10 W under what the 90 percent pod reserve sustains to the finish, speed holding

arguments.text: Out of the turn, build to 1:45 pace and hold.

text: push: shaft power held near 190 W for five minutes, about 15 W under what the 90 percent pod reserve sustains, speed flat

arguments.reason: boat reserve read empty for ten minutes at steady 165 W boat power with no fade; implied CP 164.9 W

arguments.text: You are on a wash now, lift a little and stay there.

text: hang_on: wash picked up after the turn at 190 W shaft, 15 W under the pod-sustainable 205 W; boat CP raised to 165 W from race evidence

arguments.text: Plenty in the tank, press on to 1:38 pace.

text: push: pod reserve 87 percent with 4.2 km left, shaft 192 W against 207 W sustainable, no fade

arguments.text: Strong and steady, press harder now, hold 1:45 pace.

text: push: 84 percent pod reserve with 3.2 km left, shaft 192 W against 210 W sustainable, speed holding

arguments.text: Three kilometres left, you have reserve. Lift to 1:43 pace.

text: push: 83 percent pod reserve with 3 km left, shaft 193 W against 211 W sustainable, no fade

arguments.text: Two kilometres, lots left. Build now to 1:36 pace.

text: push: 79 percent pod reserve with 1.9 km left, shaft 196 W against 219 W sustainable to the line

arguments.text: Out of this turn, go harder, hold 1:37 pace home.

text: no cue: push blocked by cooldown, a cue was spoken 51 s ago; finish-window watch will wake me

arguments.text: Lots left in the tank. Go now, sprint to the line.
